title: Hagadah book
html_source:
The typesetter reading backwards makes Bloom think of his father reading his hagadah book (Hebrew) right to left.

Book for Judaism History.

ACCEPTED SUGGESTION: Book read on Passover (Pessach), the Jewish festival celebrating the exodus from Egypt.
